purpose: Original project-owned semantic palette stories derived from general pixel-art color principles, not copied source palettes.
rarityPolicy: No palette story implies rarity. Every story may be used at any production rarity when construction and material are compatible.
sharedDarkPolicy: Several stories intentionally reuse closely related chromatic dark concepts so multiple fabric families can remain cohesive; exact role values still belong to each story.

stories.name: Everyday Neutral
stories.moodUseCase: quiet versatile basics, shirts, cardigans and restrained layering
stories.dominantTemperature: balanced neutral with a warm accent option
stories.shadowTendency: violet-charcoal recesses instead of neutral RGB darkening
stories.saturationHierarchy: low body, low secondary, moderate accent
stories.antiConvergenceNote: Use broad neutral fields; do not turn parchment into a narrow center insert.

stories.name: Warm Everyday
stories.moodUseCase: friendly casual shirts, knitwear and soft work layers
stories.saturationHierarchy: moderate body, low secondary, moderate accent
unsuitableUses: icy technical shell without hue adaptation
stories.antiConvergenceNote: Keep the cream in collars, yokes, or a broad layer—not the default bright center.

stories.name: Cool Everyday
stories.moodUseCase: clean everyday tops, polos, overshirts and soft outer layers
stories.saturationHierarchy: low-moderate body and bright-but-small accent
unsuitableUses: warm ceremonial brocade without secondary changes
stories.antiConvergenceNote: Use coral once; repeated coral piping would overwhelm the quiet cool construction.

stories.name: Soft Charcoal
stories.moodUseCase: minimal monochrome clothing that remains dimensional rather than black
stories.saturationHierarchy: very low overall
stories.antiConvergenceNote: Monochrome is a deliberate story; cap its frequency and vary dominant value topology.

stories.name: Cream Academic
stories.moodUseCase: sweater vests, cardigans, polos and light scholarly formalwear
stories.saturationHierarchy: low primary, moderate secondary/accent
stories.antiConvergenceNote: The light body is the dominant garment; do not invert it into another dark academic vest.

stories.name: Coastal Mist
stories.moodUseCase: light casual, sailor, cardigan and spring outerwear
stories.saturationHierarchy: low body and secondary, moderate accent
stories.antiConvergenceNote: Preserve the light-primary read and distribute sand by construction, not as an inner stripe.

stories.name: Sea Glass
stories.moodUseCase: fresh knits, casual shirts, light bombers and unisex formal accents
stories.saturationHierarchy: moderate primary, low secondary, moderate accent
stories.antiConvergenceNote: Do not pair this with the same open-front topology repeatedly; rotate knit, shirt and outerwear use.

stories.name: Spring Orchard
stories.moodUseCase: colorful casual, knit and patterned garments without feminine-only assumptions
stories.saturationHierarchy: moderate primary, low secondary, higher localized accent
stories.antiConvergenceNote: This is a light colorful unisex story; do not darken it to satisfy masculine heuristics.

stories.name: Lavender Day
stories.moodUseCase: pastel casual, academic knitwear and refined unisex layering
stories.saturationHierarchy: moderate primary and low supporting colors
unsuitableUses: palette used as automatic luxury signifier
stories.antiConvergenceNote: Lavender is everyday-capable and rarity-neutral; retain visible structural darks on light fabrics.

stories.name: Rosewood Pastel
stories.moodUseCase: warm pastel shirts, cardigans, sweatwear and tailored casual pieces
stories.saturationHierarchy: moderate fabric, low secondary, moderate accent
stories.antiConvergenceNote: Use on structurally masculine, feminine, or unisex garments without changing the topology.

stories.name: Autumn Knit
stories.moodUseCase: cozy sweaters, cardigans and seasonal casual tops
stories.saturationHierarchy: moderate body, restrained support, brighter small accent
stories.antiConvergenceNote: Pattern and ribbing may carry the story; avoid default brown outer-jacket mapping.

stories.name: Harvest Workwear
stories.moodUseCase: farm shirts, work jackets, utility vests and durable overshirts
stories.saturationHierarchy: moderate primary, low secondary, moderate small accent
unsuitableUses: every field garment in the same batch
stories.antiConvergenceNote: One workwear option, not the universal masculine palette.

stories.name: Forest Library
stories.moodUseCase: academic cardigans, period layers, knits and subdued formalwear
stories.saturationHierarchy: restrained body and secondary, moderate accent
stories.antiConvergenceNote: Avoid pairing forest green with military construction by default; academic and period topology should dominate.

stories.name: Winter Frost
stories.moodUseCase: winter knits, pale technical shells and crisp formal layers
stories.saturationHierarchy: low primary/secondary, moderate accent
unsuitableUses: warm rustic garment without material rationale
stories.antiConvergenceNote: Keep light ice fields large enough to remain the dominant read.

stories.name: Snowberry
stories.moodUseCase: winter pastel casualwear, knitwear and light formal pieces
stories.saturationHierarchy: low primary, moderate secondary, high small accent
stories.antiConvergenceNote: Use berry as a focal point, never as scattered confetti.

stories.name: Denim Blue
stories.moodUseCase: denim-like shirts, work jackets, overshirts and casual outerwear
stories.dominantTemperature: cool blue with warm workwear support
stories.saturationHierarchy: moderate primary, low secondary, moderate accent
stories.antiConvergenceNote: Denim is material-specific; rotate light, colorful and non-blue casual stories.

stories.name: Bright Sport
stories.moodUseCase: track jackets, polos, sport shells and bold casual tops
stories.dominantTemperature: cool blue with warm orange accent
stories.accentBehavior: small hot orange stripe or fastening
stories.saturationHierarchy: high primary, low secondary, high localized accent
stories.antiConvergenceNote: Use large sport blocks; never reduce orange to the same recurring center zipper formula.

stories.name: Retro Track
stories.moodUseCase: retro sport shells, cardigans and playful streetwear
stories.saturationHierarchy: moderate primary/secondary with controlled bright accent
unsuitableUses: automatic nostalgia treatment across a batch
stories.antiConvergenceNote: Change block topology by article; purple/yellow alone does not create retro variety.

stories.name: Street Neon
stories.moodUseCase: streetwear and sport pieces with one luminous focal system
stories.accentBehavior: localized neon mint with optional pink motif, never both at equal coverage
stories.saturationHierarchy: low body, low secondary, very high tiny accent
stories.antiConvergenceNote: Choose mint or pink as the primary focal color per garment; the other is omitted or used once.

stories.name: Cyber Night
stories.moodUseCase: technical streetwear and high-contrast statement panels
stories.accentBehavior: one magenta focal plus an optional tiny cyan echo
stories.saturationHierarchy: low-mid shell, very high localized accents
unsuitableUses: plain cotton basics with both neon roles active
stories.antiConvergenceNote: Neon geometry must follow real panels; no floating cyber speckles.

stories.name: Formal Pearl
stories.moodUseCase: light blazers, waistcoats and refined ceremonial-adjacent garments
stories.accentBehavior: muted wine focal; metal remains subdued
stories.saturationHierarchy: low fabrics, moderate accent, low metal
stories.antiConvergenceNote: Pearl can be Common, Uncommon, or Rare; quality comes from tailoring, not pale color or metal.

stories.name: Formal Midnight
stories.moodUseCase: dark formalwear with clean shirt contrast and restrained warmth
stories.saturationHierarchy: restrained body, low secondary, moderate accent
stories.antiConvergenceNote: The ivory must form a shirt/lapel relationship, never a thin bright center.

stories.name: Luxury Neutral
stories.moodUseCase: premium-feeling normal garments without spectacle-coded hues
stories.accentBehavior: muted mauve or restrained brass, not both prominently
stories.saturationHierarchy: low fabrics and controlled support
unsuitableUses: spectacle identity based only on metal
stories.antiConvergenceNote: Premium restraint is compatible with any rarity; do not treat beige plus brass as Legendary shorthand.

stories.name: Gothic Silver
stories.moodUseCase: dark fashion, formalwear and knitwear with controlled cool metal
stories.accentBehavior: muted plum focal; silver hardware remains tiny
stories.saturationHierarchy: very low fabrics, modest accent
unsuitableUses: default palette for all alt or masculine clothing
stories.antiConvergenceNote: Gothic identity requires topology and value design; silver dots cannot carry it.

stories.name: Sailor Navy
stories.moodUseCase: sailor tops, coastal shirts, cardigans and crisp sport pieces
stories.saturationHierarchy: moderate body, low secondary, moderate accent
stories.antiConvergenceNote: Reserve broad rear collar and trim topology for sailor grammar; palette alone is not sailor identity.

stories.name: Earth & Moss
stories.moodUseCase: knitwear, workwear, cardigans and adventure tops
stories.saturationHierarchy: restrained body and secondary, moderate accent
unsuitableUses: default shorthand for fantasy or masculinity
stories.antiConvergenceNote: Use on non-military construction as often as fieldwear; rotate with light and bright stories.

stories.name: Celestial Dusk
stories.moodUseCase: statement knitwear, formal tops and restrained fantasy/adventure garments
stories.accentBehavior: one warm star-gold focal with optional tiny pale cyan echo
stories.saturationHierarchy: moderate fabrics, higher localized accent
stories.antiConvergenceNote: One celestial focal region only; dusk purple is not a rarity code.

stories.name: Sun Ember
stories.moodUseCase: bright adventure, sport, knit and statement casual garments
stories.dominantTemperature: warm orange with cool indigo support
stories.saturationHierarchy: high primary, moderate secondary, high tiny accent
stories.antiConvergenceNote: Let orange dominate a real garment field; avoid reducing it to the same tiny warm accent used elsewhere.

stories.name: Ceremonial Ivory
stories.moodUseCase: light ceremonial, period and statement formalwear
stories.accentBehavior: one restrained red focal; metal remains secondary
stories.saturationHierarchy: low primary, moderate secondary/accent
unsuitableUses: rarity inferred from ivory or metal
stories.antiConvergenceNote: Ceremonial identity must come from garment grammar and focal hierarchy, not ivory/gold shorthand.

stories.name: High-Contrast Statement
stories.moodUseCase: street, sport, formal or adventure garments built around large decisive regions
stories.accentBehavior: one red focal; optional ochre motif is mutually restrained
stories.saturationHierarchy: low light primary, high secondary and localized accent
unsuitableUses: all roles active at equal coverage
stories.antiConvergenceNote: Large construction-following regions are mandatory; high contrast cannot be a narrow center stripe plus dots.
